Digital micromirror device.fact: The DMD was invented by solid-state physicist and TI Fellow Emeritus Larry Hornbeck in 1987.

Digital micromirror device.subject: Applied Sciences
Digital micromirror device.question: The project at _____ began as the deformable mirror device in 1977 using micromechanical analog light modulators
Digital micromirror device.fact: The digital micromirror device, or DMD, is the microoptoelectromechanical system (MOEMS) that is the core of the trademarked digital light processing (DLP) projection technology from Texas Instruments (TI). The project at Texas Instruments began as the deformable mirror device in 1977 using micromechanical analog light modulators.

Digital Project.subject: Applied Sciences
Digital Project.question: The _____ was Computer-aided design software application.
Digital Project.fact: Digital Project is a computer-aided design (CAD) software application based on CATIA V5 and developed by Gehry Technologies, a technology company owned by the architect Frank Gehry. With the release of version R5 Digital Project is compatible with CATIA V5R22.

Digital Project.subject: Applied Sciences
Digital Project.question: Among the changes made by _____ to CATIA is a new visual interface suitable for architecture work
Digital Project.fact: Digital Project is a computer-aided design (CAD) software application based on CATIA V5 and developed by Gehry Technologies, a technology company owned by the architect Frank Gehry. Among the changes made by Gehry Technologies to CATIA is a new visual interface suitable for architecture work.

Digital Project.subject: Applied Sciences
Digital Project.question: It has been used on projects such as Sagrada Familia, _____, Ray and Maria Stata Center, Walt Disney Concert Hall and Hejmdal, The Danish Cancer Societies House
Digital Project.fact: Digital Project is widely called the software used to design the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, and the Louis Vuitton Foundation. It has been used on projects such as Sagrada Familia, Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, Ray and Maria Stata Center, Walt Disney Concert Hall and Hejmdal, The Danish Cancer Societies House.

Digital Project.fact: In 2014, Trimble acquired Gehry Technology, the developers of Digital Project.
